reading_source: Checked every term against the user-provided master deck, section 1: 刃の部分. マチ is spoken まち; lexical 刃 は is retained. No sentence particles or phrase boundaries in these standalone terms. Reviewed title 刃の部分 → はのぶぶん; の links the noun phrase. Page 2: all 14 vocabulary readings checked against supplied section 2, 刃の形; カーブ → かーぶ, lexical は retained in はがた/はさき/ははば/はわたり; no は/へ/を particles to change. 刃幅 ははば independently confirmed by blade manufacturer https://kawasei.asia/2021/12/20/491/. Eight unconfirmed page 2 accents rendered provisionally with explicit user authorization. Page 3: all eleven term readings checked against supplied section 3; テーパー → てーぱー and ディスタルテーパー → でぃすたるてーぱー preserve long vowels and ディ. Lexical は in はあつ retained; が remains attached in せんたんがうすい. Heading uses speech-only comma between 厚さ and テーパー. Page 4: all sixteen readings checked against supplied section 4. Lexical は in はつけ/はかく/はさきかく/はまぐりば retained; compound づ in こばづけ preserved. フラット and コンベックス preserve doubled consonants; ホロー preserves the long vowel. No sentence particles or added pauses. Industry reading checks: 刃付け はつけ confirmed at https://www.jtco.or.jp/tradition_report/?id=27; 片刃 かたば at https://www.sakaidensan.mom/knife-finder. Page 5: seven readings checked against supplied section 5. Six existing term recordings reused with unchanged lookup keys; 表 is おもて in the bevel-side context. Heading 片刃の構造 → かたばのこうぞう, retaining the long vowel in こうぞう and continuous の phrase. Page 6: twelve terms checked against supplied section 6. 柄 is え in handle context (not がら or つか); D型ハンドル uses でぃーがたはんどる. Preserve long vowels in ようえ and こうぞう and doubled consonants in はっかくえ and りべっと. 中子 reuses existing なかご key. Page 7: eight vocabulary readings checked against supplied section 7; seven full-sentence explanations manually reviewed for context. Object を → お in 刃を and 元素を/などを; lexical は retained in はがね/は/はもち/はものこう. 地金 → じがね, 日常使い → にちじょうづかい, 耐摩耗性 → たいまもうせい. Speech-only pauses follow complete clauses; no pauses inserted before particles. Display text and lookup keys preserved. Page 8: nine steel names and three explanations checked against supplied section 8. 白紙 → しろがみ for White Steel, not はくし; 青紙 → あおがみ, 黄紙 → きがみ. Grade numbers 一/二/三号 → いち/に/さんごう; スーパー → すーぱー. Object を → お in 合金元素を and 刃持ちを; lexical は in 刃/刃持ち retained. Clause pauses keep particles attached. Page 9: eleven terms checked against supplied section 9; alloy codes explicitly expanded as Japanese letter names plus numeric values, not unverified trade-name aliases. Four explanations manually reviewed: 和包丁 → わぼうちょう, 家庭用包丁 → かていようほうちょう, 重視 → じゅうし. Object を → お in 刃を and 性能を; lexical は retained in 刃/刃持ち. 粉末鋼 reuses the existing key. Speech-only commas separate heading topics and SG2/R2 alternatives. Page 10: all eight element names checked against supplied section 10 and exact spelling entries in the pinned accent dictionary. Katakana converted to reviewed hiragana: クロム → くろむ, モリブデン → もりぶでん, タングステン → たんぐすてん, バナジウム → ばなじうむ, コバルト → こばると, マンガン → まんがん, ニッケル → にっける (double consonant preserved). Heading 鋼 → はがね in steel-material context; の stays attached. Page 11: all sixteen readings checked against supplied section 11. HRC uses Japanese letter names えいちあーるしー; ロックウェル → ろっくうぇる preserves っ/うぇ. 靭性 → じんせい, 耐摩耗性 → たいまもうせい, 耐食性 → たいしょくせい. Lexical は in はもち retained; が stays attached in short predicate phrases, without inserted pauses. 鋼の性質 → はがねのせいしつ. Page 12: thirteen vocabulary readings checked against supplied section 12; three explanations manually reviewed. 芯/芯材 → しん/しんざい, 地金 → じがね, 覆い → おおい, 合わせ包丁 → あわせぼうちょう. Object を → お in 刃持ちを, 芯材を, 包丁全体を, 芯を, 部分を; lexical は in はさき/はがね/はもち retained. クラッド → くらっど preserves doubled consonant; speech-only heading comma separates complete topics. Page 13: all seven terms checked against supplied section 13. ダマスカス → だますかす; 鋼 suffix → こう; 積層 → せきそう, 多層 → たそう, 模様 → もよう preserve long vowels. 波模様 → なみもよう. Speech-only heading comma separates the two complete topics; no sentence particles need alteration. Page 14: ten finish names checked against supplied section 14. 梨地 → なしじ, 槌目 → つちめ, 黒打ち → くろうち, 本霞 → ほんかすみ. ヘアライン → へあらいん and サテン → さてん; lexical へ is retained, not changed to え. 表面 → ひょうめん, 鏡面 → きょうめん preserve long vowels. No contextual particles need alteration. Page 15: all fourteen vocabulary/group labels and seven explanations checked against supplied section 15. 朴 → ほお (magnolia context, not えのき); 木目 → もくめ, 手触り → てざわり, 水牛角 → すいぎゅうづの, 和柄 → わえ, 柄 → え. Object を → お in 見た目を and 違いを. Lexical へ in へんけい retained. Long vowels preserved; commas follow complete clauses or list items, never immediately before particles. Page 16: six vocabulary readings checked against supplied section 16, with five exact dictionary matches; two explanation readings manually reviewed. 真鍮 → しんちゅう and 銅 → どう preserve long vowels, 接着剤 → せっちゃくざい preserves っ. 研磨剤 → けんまざい, 口金 → くちがね, 装飾 → そうしょく, 積層材 → せきそうざい. その他 → そのほか. No は/へ/を particles require alteration; commas follow complete clauses. Page 17: all ten readings checked against supplied section 17. 錆 → さび, 赤錆 → あかさび, 黒錆 → くろさび, 変色 → へんしょく, 酸化 → さんか; パティナ → ぱてぃな preserves ティ. Lexical へ in へんしょく retained. Object を → お only in さびをおとす; keep さびお continuous with no pause before the particle. Heading comma separates complete topics. Page 18: all ten readings checked against supplied section 18. 鈍い/鈍る → にぶい/にぶる in dull-edge context; 鋭い → するどい, 欠け → かけ. Lexical 刃 は retained in はが/はこぼれ/はさき, never changed to わ. が attaches to the preceding noun and predicate stays connected; no speech-only pauses added. 状態 → じょうたい preserves the long vowel. Page 19: ten readings checked against supplied section 19. 重量 → じゅうりょう and 重心 → じゅうしん preserve long vowels. 後ろ → うしろ in balance context; 手に馴染む → てになじむ, 握りやすい → にぎりやすい. が/に stay attached; no internal pauses added to predicate phrases. Heading comma separates the complete topics. Page 20: eight measurement readings checked against supplied section 20. Seven vocabulary keys reuse existing reviewed recordings, preserving the user-supplied L-H-H target and authorized kanji input for 刃厚. 寸法 → すんぽう and 角度 → かくど have exact dictionary readings and accents. Long vowels in すんぽう/じゅうりょう/ぜんちょう and lexical は remain unchanged. Page 21: seventeen comparison readings checked against supplied section 21. Five terms reuse existing clips. 細い → ほそい (not こまい), 丈夫 → じょうぶ (durable context), 柔らかい → やわらかい. Lexical は in はばひろい retained. Heading object を → お in ほうちょうを; keep it attached without a pause. 手入れ → ていれ, 必要 → ひつよう preserve the correct vowels; predicate phrases remain continuous.
